decision: 我批准 SOB1 第一阶段，签发前完成两项 $0 修正，针对性回归和最终 dry run 通过后直接启动。……第一阶段用一张 L40S，预期 $10.21，所有 attempt 累计硬上限 $22.92，另留 $1.00 专用于关闭资源。签发和启动时复核实时余额、报价和实际落盘空间。可恢复故障在剩余额度内自主修复，优先接管已验证的 checkpoint、深度搜索轮次和逐题结果。……本次授权仅覆盖 SOB1 第一阶段。第二阶段持久存储、Stage 3 恢复训练额度及合入 main 另行决定。（maintainer, 2026-11-19 UTC; reviewed at 654a686f after the two corrections and the final $0 dry run passed）
hardware: one NVIDIA L40S per session, secure cloud, at most $1.11/h, 150 GB container disk; the packed search's DEPTH ran on the same card (29.5 GiB reserved); no network volume

sob1_train.status: not proposed: phase 2 needs the maintainer's own decision and a cap the project's remainder does not hold (phase_2_draft)

depth_only.rule: derived from TPI1's measured peak, not measured at this size; the first optimizer steps of the first unit measure it (the trainer's gpu_mem_gb / gpu_mem_reserved_gb)

ffn_attention.rule: derived from TPI1's measured peak, not measured at this size; the first optimizer steps of the first unit measure it (the trainer's gpu_mem_gb / gpu_mem_reserved_gb)

residual_width.rule: derived from TPI1's measured peak, not measured at this size; the first optimizer steps of the first unit measure it (the trainer's gpu_mem_gb / gpu_mem_reserved_gb)

money_rules.ceiling: $22.92: phase 1's one session at its hard cap, cumulatively over every attempt
money_rules.own_envelope: the ceiling counts only this study's runs; TPI1, RI-S1, RI-LM1 and Research A are CLOSED and fund nothing here; a provider top-up is not a grant
money_rules.project_cap: the $1,000 project cap is not raised by this proposal
money_rules.resume: a replacement attempt takes over every arm whose init record verified and every sealed sample; its cap is what the ceiling leaves
money_rules.teardown_reserve: $1.00 held outside the ceiling and never issued: each artifact's hard cap plus the reserve must fit what the project cap and the provider balance leave, at issue and at launch (layer_merge_launch.reserve_problems)

completion_checks_and_comparison_minutes.basis: measured on the dev box: one completion check of a set, its formal report rescored, 1.0 s (non-thinking) to 3.0 s (thinking) on TPI1's A records at 8,192; about 40 checks over the eight sets (start, after generating, after rescoring, the phase check) and the comparison table's rescoring

depth.rule: rounds 9-20 at the journal's 27.2 s per candidate x remaining / 32.5 (expected) or x 1 (bound) plus round 8's re-score, the bound x 1.15

residual_width_statistics.rule: no teacher statistics pass (the journal's replay was 172 s): TPI1's sealed file is downloaded by setup and loaded here; its time is priced into the driver so the session's hard deadline covers it

phase_2_draft.status: a draft for the maintainer: no cap here is proposed for a grant, and the project cap is not raised

scope: phase 1 of SOB1 only (configs/stages/stage-1/single_operator_budget/design.json): one sob1_phase1 session builds the three ~2B initializations from the original teacher with A's operators (depth only resumed from the recorded search's round 9) and evaluates each untrained arm and the teacher on all of eval-set-1 in both modes at 8,192 tokens. No training, no other arm, no network volume. Phase 2 (recovery training and its evaluation) is a separate draft below and proposes no cap

storage.rule: a save point is deleted only after the next one hands off, so a rotation holds two; a final is uploaded while its unit's last save point still exists; the dev box keeps the inits (phase 1) and would keep the finals after their evaluation (phase 2)

authorizes: SOB1's phase only (scope): its session kinds ['sob1_phase1', 'sob1_train'], inside ceiling_usd cumulatively, per_session_hard_cap_usd per session and the project cap; one-use artifacts from `issue`; no other study and no follow-up
